notes.title: Townopolis v1.6.11 Patch

notes.title: Townopolis v1.54 patch
notes.notes:
v1.54 changes:
-Windows executable is now 64-bit by default. A separate 32-bit executable is provided for a backward compatibility.
-Fixed a small visual glitch on low resolution displays.
-macOS application bundle rearranged to the regular format
-macOS system requirement increased from 10.6 to 10.8
